ns2:section.sectionText: Special Topics: Print Media will explore ways of thinking through a variety of historical and contemporary print methods and traditions. These courses encourage connections between content and form while developing heightened sensitivity to materials, processes and presentation. Digital and traditional routes are used to explore both the physical and the conceptual implications of the ways things are made. Projects that intersect with work developed in other studio and design areas will be encouraged. Graduate section.
